snapshot..github/workflows/experiment.yml:
name: Controlled experiment
run-name: ${{ inputs.correlation }}
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      correlation:
        required: true
        type: string
      cache_key:
        required: true
        type: string
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  plan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.matrix }}
      cache: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.cache }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - id: plan
        run: node ci/matrix.ts
  tests:
    needs: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 4
      matrix: ${{ fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.matrix) }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - id: dependencies
        if: needs.plan.outputs.cache == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830
        with:
          path: node_modules
          key: deps-${{ inputs.cache_key }}-${{ matrix.partition }}-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}
      - if: steps.dependencies.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - run: node ci/execute.ts
        env:
          PARTITION: ${{ matrix.partition }}
          CACHE_KEY: ${{ inputs.cache_key }}
          CACHE_HIT: ${{ steps.dependencies.outputs.cache-hit }}
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: execution-${{ matrix.partition }}
          path: execution.json
          retention-days: 1
          if-no-files-found: error

1-review.explanation: The patch modifies ci/plan.json to split the single partition into two partitions (even/odd). Deterministic validation passes all checks, including partition-limit. However, the paired acceptance test (paired-log-t95-v1) fails because the observed mean ratios (primary 1.035, secondary 1.536) miss at least one configured threshold. All individual test cases pass, but the statistical significance criteria are not satisfied. To determine if the partition change yields a meaningful improvement, additional paired experiments are needed to increase statistical power and verify that the ratios meet the required thresholds.
